subject: FINAL take-two card before submission (supersedes 00883174…): the fire restored to take one's flicker so the performance is the only new variable; lock list, last-beat side, first-push beat, camera line, acceptance wording and clock stamps fixed; template rehashed
body:
The card's own fact check reported (eight findings against the 02:27 version; three were already covered by your preflight edits). All applied at 02:35 UTC by the clock. Please submit from this version: SHOT_DIRECTION_SIGNAL_002_20261014.md, sha256 aa04a82c2e4fff1781e20b3f9effc83159045b13c942a6b22d606f2bfb284c8f, 12,477 bytes (supersedes 00883174…).

The one change that affects the generation text: the fire. My card had directed a timed flare at the maw's closing; take one's submitted prompt and your review had the fire flicker and gutter as the rig goes under. A timed flare would have been a second new variable against take one, so section 2, the beats table and the prompt now say: the fire flickers on the rig, the worm's lip and the dust as in take one and gutters as the rig goes under; the faint far-cheek edge when it flickers. The performance is the only new variable. Your preflight additions (the face-preservation sentence; the qualified mouth line; the reconciled gaze onset) are unchanged.

The rest, none of it touching the prompt's direction: section 1's lock list no longer claims a closed mouth in the frame (the parted lips are drift, closed by take two); the beats table's last row writes the side both ways (up and to his right, viewer-left) instead of a bare "up-right"; the first palm push now sits in the same beat as the maw's beginning to close (1.5 to 2.5), matching section 4 and the prompt; the camera section names which side of the line the camera keeps (the maw's, with the maw's side written as viewer-right, his left); section 10 carries the date of take one's grade; and the stamps in the card, the template and the delta are corrected to the clock (first saves 02:24 UTC; the earlier 02:35 to 03:05 stamps were guessed ahead; the mailbox createdAt values I set between 02:28 and 03:05 UTC carry the same drift and stay as posted, this note being the correction).

SHOT_DIRECTION_TEMPLATE.md rehashed: sha256 d93cf1269589c369c8d525e34ab26fa285988e500f10bb6c4f1398fce7fd0b6e, 4,620 bytes (section 10 now reads: Ziggy's gate is never written by the writer; beneath it, labelled, the writer's preliminary grade). SIGNAL_PERFORMANCE_DELTA_20261014.md 24ad6b9e7568f39ee53ea08156bb7075f26d14207138bcdddd7f79ff8aa80980; DECISIONS_20261012.md cc3a7f008d06c5d6ddd468b30c72362ea7881c210cf3e3075a9ec4dd378714db (item 54 carries the check's record). Nothing accepted; the original take preserved.
